departures.name: Erica Shen
departures.note: Inaugural resident (entry 2020). PGY4 in 2023-24 AND 2024-25 (consistent with a research year). GME page 2025-08-09 still listed her unadvanced at PGY4; dropped from dept page by 2025-11-11 and GME page by 2026-02-12; absent 2026-27. PHASE 2: July 2025 bioRxiv (doi 10.1101/2025.07.11.664189, PMID 40791422) lists her at Department of Neurosurgery, Yale University (Verhaak lab; same OpenAlex author A5062832120 as her UConn/JAX papers; 2022 paper co-authored with Verhaak). She is on no Yale NS residency roster (program 123) -> research affiliation, not a transfer. Outcome: LEFT, did not complete; destination/specialty unknown. training_history row inserted (completed='no', departure_type='unknown', end_year 2025). NPPES 'switch' = wrong person, not used.
